- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (`Diagnostic.Code`; Resolver, Parser, Lexer, CSharpProvider; `docs/GRAMMAR.md`; corpus `.expected.json`; `Diagnostics/baseline.txt`)
- **Source:** product-owner decision 2026-11-08 (OPEN: rename diagnostic codes from PH to AV before the v0.1 preview); D127 no backward compatibility; card 189 listed AV codes as out of scope; card 202 added PH337 and card 189 added PH020 and PH340.
- **Depends on:** none. Ranked ahead of the v0.1 publish card (188) and immediately before card 162, so that the 162 re-freeze ratifies AV codes in docs/GRAMMAR.md (D127: 162 is the single final re-freeze; this card must not follow it).
- **Story:** As Dana, I want every diagnostic code to use the AV prefix, so that the codes I read, paste and search are Avowry's before the preview publishes them.
- **Consumer value:** Dana reads AV325 in the CLI, the grammar table and the docs; Ari keys on the same codes in docs and prompts. Numbers stay: PH325 becomes AV325.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [O][S][B][I] compiler prints AVnnn
     Given any compile error
     When Dana runs `avowry build` or `avowry trace`
     Then the CLI prints AVnnn (line:col) with the same numbers and no PHnnn; the map and the trace contain no PHnnn
  2. Scenario: [M] living docs
     Given the grammar table, the cheat sheet and the docs
     When the card merges
     Then they use AV and no PHnnn remains outside history (`.mob/records` and decision records stay)
  3. Scenario: [Z][E] guard and orders hash
     Given src/, tests/ and the living docs (docs/GRAMMAR.md, docs/CHEATSHEET.md, docs/PATTERNS.md, docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md, docs/TRACEABILITY.md, TEAM_WORKING_AGREEMENT.md; not docs/decisions or docs/retros, which are history)
     When a later change introduces a PHnnn diagnostic code string
     Then a guard test fails; generated C# for orders.avowry keeps hash `19fe6d711cc6d8289489da037c78bc2b308e1b4a9118c8812574771ef0e61765`
  Letters that do not apply: none ([Z] empty living PH tree; [E] the guard; [B] unchanged numbers).
